name: @forum4ai/e2e
description: Playwright E2E — 3 projects: `dev` (anonymous, nsec login, NIP-07/46 modal, logout on the dev stack), `owner` (CSP + approve/revoke with NIP-98 on the VPS), `chain` (F4AI-20 full chain over vite preview)

scripts.test: echo '@forum4ai/e2e is deliberately outside `pnpm -r test` — Playwright needs a downloaded browser and a live stack, so it runs only via `pnpm test:e2e` from the repo root (or `pnpm run test:e2e` here).' && exit 0
scripts.build: echo 'the e2e package has no build step — Playwright runs TypeScript directly through its own loader' && exit 0
